title: 'love here isn’t a slogan. It’s the input that makes the economics work'
summary: Manus traces Figure 5.2's flywheel — service to trust to members accepting help at multiples of the normal rate to better outcomes to lower costs and back. She says it is why she puts humility at the top of her list of investable founder traits.
blockquote: What struck me is that love here isn't a slogan. It's the input that makes the economics work.
